commit.message:
fix(config): isolate chainless explorer caches (#18487)

* fix(config): cache chain-less explorers by endpoint

Explorer responses are cached for 24 hours under a directory chosen by
chain, with a file name derived from the contract address alone. A
chain-less `[etherscan]` entry fell back to the mainnet directory, so
its responses were served to mainnet lookups of the same address and
vice versa, and every chain-less entry shared that one directory.

Cache such entries under a directory derived from their API endpoint
instead, keeping the host readable and disambiguating endpoints on the
same host with a URL digest. Chain-bound entries keep their chain
directory.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.2 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* docs(config): fix private intra-doc link

* test(config): drop cache prefix assertion

* fix(config): isolate explorer cache paths

Use a new mainnet response-cache namespace so chainless explorer responses from older versions cannot be reused by chain-bound mainnet requests. Derive chainless cache directories from the full endpoint hash, keeping credentials and query values out of filesystem paths.

* fix(common): invalidate legacy explorer layouts

Layouts compiled from the old shared mainnet explorer response cache can retain another endpoint’s data indefinitely. Bump the layout cache version so upgrades fetch sources again, and update the CLI fixture to the current version.

* test(config): trim redundant explorer cache tests

Merge the two chainless cache-dir regression tests into one, drop tests
that restate the implementation or duplicate the existing cache-version
test, and format the endpoint digest with B256's LowerHex instead of
hex::encode.
